hypotheses.title: Cross-Dataset Synergy: Inverted Supply Chain Spillover & Earnings Certainty Anchor
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In Batch 235, Candidate 2 achieved Sharpe 1.29 and Sub-Universe Sharpe 0.69 with 32.7% turnover, while Candidate 3 (model16 quality) achieved Sharpe 0.87 with an ultra-low 2.68% turnover. Uniting these two completely orthogonal virgin alpha drivers creates a high-Sharpe multi-factor alpha. The slow earnings certainty anchor locks core capital in high-predictability firms, compressing portfolio turnover from 32.7% into the optimal 16-20% window and projecting Sharpe > 1.45 and Fitness >= 1.50.
confounders: Simultaneous industry-wide earnings revisions and supply-chain contract cancellations
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if combining earnings certainty with customer shocks increases portfolio drawdown or fails to lower turnover.

hypotheses.title: Cross-Dataset Synergy: Inverted Customer Shock & Composite Quality Momentum
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Combines agile 5-day inverted customer return shocks with 5-day linearly smoothed volume damping and the unmined model16 composite factor score derivative. Blending fast supply-chain mean-reversion with medium-term multi-factor operational quality anchors portfolio turnover at ~18%, driving platform Fitness past 1.50 with near-zero correlation to approved alphas.
confounders: Protracted market drawdowns where composite factor momentum temporarily underperforms
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if composite factor score derivative fails to maintain positive returns across market sub-universes.

hypotheses.title: 5-Day Smoothed Volume Ratio Scaled Customer Shock with Extended Decay 10
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Candidate 2 of Batch 235 achieved Sharpe 1.29 with raw daily volume ranking. Smoothing the volume ratio over 5 days (ts_mean(volume / adv20, 5)) eliminates single-day volume spikes, and simulating with platform Decay 10 directly smooths daily portfolio holdings across days, cutting turnover from 32.7% to under 20% while preserving the Sharpe 1.29 customer shock engine.
confounders: Sustained liquidity drought causing 5-day volume mean to misrepresent current execution costs
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if Decay 10 over-smooths the alpha and causes Sharpe to drop below 1.25.
